module_sync_desc: Keeps chosen files and folders the same across builds
sync_how_when: The launcher makes the chosen files the same before a game starts and after it closes.
sync_how_wins: The edit made last wins; in a group with a base build, the base's files always win.
sync_how_history: What a build changed itself and a sync overwrites or removes goes to the group's history, where it can be restored.
sync_how_packs: Tip: the resource packs turned on live in options.txt: choose it and the resourcepacks folder.
sync_mode_latest_desc: The file edited last wins, in whichever build.
sync_mode_base_desc: The other builds always take the base's files and lose their own edits.
sync_delete_confirm: Delete the group “{group}”? The files in the builds stay as they are.
sync_waiting_toast: The sync waits: a build it needs is running
sync_empty_desc: A group keeps chosen files and folders (settings, a minimap, resource packs) the same across builds.
sync_tab_empty: This build is in no sync group
sync_managed_in: In {builds} the server manages this: it is not touched there
sync_summary: Builds: {builds}. Paths: {paths} ({shown}), {size}. The first sync takes them from “{start}”.
sync_summary_base: Builds: {builds}. Paths: {paths} ({shown}), {size}. The others always take them from the base “{start}”.
sync_mismatch: The builds run different versions or loaders: mods and configs made for another version may not start.
sync_history_empty: The sync has overwritten none of your changes yet
sync_restored: The version is restored and synced
sync_conflict: “{group}”: edited in more than one build: {path}. The newest edit was kept; the others are in the group's history
sync_failed_before_launch: Unable to sync “{group}” before the launch. The reason is on the Sync page.
sync_idle_note: Add another build to the group, or delete the group.
sync_error_busy: “{group}” is already syncing. Try again in a moment.
sync_error_start: The starting build must be in the group.
sync_error_path_invalid: “{path}” is not a path inside the build's folder.
sync_error_path_blocked: “{path}” is never synced: worlds, logs and the launcher's own files stay apart.
sync_error_version_gone: This version is no longer in the history.
sync_error_restore_running: “{version}” is running. Close the game and restore again.
sync_error_restore_managed: In “{version}”, the server keeps “{path}”; it cannot be restored there.
